notes: Read SKILL.md in full; it is the only file. Short SOPS guide: installing sops, encrypting/decrypting/editing files with AWS KMS or PGP keys, a .sops.yaml creation-rules example, a SOPS-encrypted Kubernetes Secret, and best practices.

Following it can make the agent install sops via brew or by downloading the v3.8.0 release binary from GitHub and moving it into /usr/local/bin (SKILL.md:34-36), and run sops commands that use the user's KMS/PGP keys; 'sops --decrypt' prints decrypted secrets to stdout (SKILL.md:46). Medium because it installs a downloaded binary and handles real secrets with the user's keys; acceptable because the download is version-pinned from the official repository (no checksum shown), nothing is piped to a shell, and decrypting is part of the user's own secret-management task.

KMS ARNs and the PGP fingerprint are placeholders; the ArgoCD/ksops section is a comment only. Related Skills (SKILL.md:99-100) link to sibling skills (../hashicorp-vault/, ../../../devops/orchestration/argocd-gitops/) that do not ship with this skill; optional. Frontmatter declares license: MIT.
